rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a warning, including one given to a person or issued in writing.

example.english: This warning is very clear; don't do it again.
example.traditional: 呢個警告寫得好清楚，唔好再犯喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ging2 gou3 se2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2 m4 hou2 zoi3 faan6 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a physical warning sign or notice displayed for people to see.

example.english: There's a warning sign ahead, so drive more slowly.
example.traditional: 前面有塊警告牌，慢啲揸車。
example.jyutping: cin4 min6 jau5 faai3 ging2 gou3 paai4 maan6 di1 zaa1 ce1
